title: feat: centralize portable tooling observations in Python metadata producer
body:
> **Status (2026-10-05 JST)**: Producer slice #51 (`f370e594`) is on main, and the first downstream consumer is now integrated: [web-ui #38](https://github.com/myon-bioinformatics/web-ui/pull/38) merged as `53ea218fae0dab039384a12bbdfcdab7348ee52a`. Current web-ui `tool/tooling_meta.py` delegates portable observations to canonical `collect_portable_tooling()`; it is no longer the pre-#51 / local-probe consumer described in the historical 2026-10-04 snapshot below. Keep this issue open for the remaining Flutter / mcp-toolcall-lab consumer boundaries. This is status reconciliation, not completion of the entire rollout.

## Goal

After the repository-metadata v1 rollout is stable, move portable repository/tooling observation out of JavaScript and Dart collectors and into the stdlib-only Python producer wherever Python can obtain the same fact reliably.

This is a follow-up to #45/#46, not a change to the current stable v1 rollout.

## Python-owned observations

Prefer Python stdlib mechanisms only:

- Python runtime: `platform` / `sys`
- Git version and checkout facts: `subprocess` + canonical checkout-HEAD logic
- GitHub CLI version when present: `shutil.which("gh")` + `subprocess`
- Node / npm / npx versions when present: `shutil.which` + `subprocess`
- selected Python package versions: `importlib.metadata`
- timestamps / platform-neutral normalization: stdlib
- optional command availability/version observations must be nonfatal

Do not add Node/Dart/runtime dependencies to the producer.

## Consumer boundary

### web-ui
Implemented by [web-ui #38](https://github.com/myon-bioinformatics/web-ui/pull/38): `tool/tooling_meta.py` delegates generic observations to the canonical Python producer and only projects the result into its existing timestamp/runtime/commands/packages layout. Unavailable observations are omitted rather than filled with null; empty groups remain `{}`. JS remains renderer/consumer and presentation-safety owner.

### flutter_navigation_basic
Python should own generic repository identity/head/tool versions. Dart remains responsible for Flutter/app-specific observations that Python cannot authoritatively infer from the build layer, including app version/build/stage, build platform/mode, artifact/analyze-size measurements, screen/route weights and checkout/build-specific dirty evidence where appropriate.

## Contract design requirement

Current v1 `tooling` values are short non-null strings. Do **not** silently change that shape.

Before implementation, choose and test a backward-compatible representation for unavailable/unmeasured tools. Prefer either:
1. omit unavailable tooling keys while keeping v1 string values, if absence has an unambiguous documented meaning; or
2. deliberately version the contract if explicit null/status objects are needed.

Do not make ad-hoc per-consumer null conventions.

## Naming

Use canonical `repository_metadata` naming for producer/contract artifacts. Keep `repository_diagnostics` for presentation/Pages consumers because those are different semantic layers.

## Acceptance

- stdlib-only producer
- missing commands/packages are observational and nonfatal
- deterministic normalization
- no credentials, absolute paths or private remotes in public metadata
- tests for installed/missing commands, malformed version output, package present/absent
- web-ui and Flutter migration guidance backed by their existing issues
- JSON/JSONL equivalence remains intact
- no regression to #46 checkout-HEAD coherence


## Residual scope reconciliation — 2026-09-30 (historical)

[PR #51](https://github.com/myon-bioinformatics/Ironmate/pull/51) merged as `f370e594727045b105a62140334596cb2e6dc0fa`.

The producer-owned tooling normalization/observation slice is implemented. Downstream web-ui/Flutter migration and generic measurement unification remain separate follow-up work. Keep this parent issue open until its consumer boundary is reconciled; do not reimplement the producer slice.

## Consumer state — 2026-10-04 (historical; web-ui superseded below)

The following is the pre-web-ui-#38 snapshot, not the current web-ui state:

- Ironmate main contains #51 (`f370e594727045b105a62140334596cb2e6dc0fa`): `normalize_version_output`, `observe_command_version`, `observe_package_version` and `collect_portable_tooling` in `repository_metadata_generator.py`.
- web-ui (`58d56ccb`): `tool/vendor/repository_metadata_generator.py` is pinned to #46 `0aee64da2f8d0119a3ef9b955e5c3818f28aaf92` (no `collect_portable_tooling`). `tool/tooling_meta.py` still collects `git` / `gh` / `node` / `npx` versions with its own `shutil.which` + `subprocess` probe, plus `pytest` / `stagehand` via `importlib.metadata`, and stores `None` for missing tools. That is the duplicated generic observation this issue targets. This remains the first consumer slice.
- flutter_navigation_basic (`7e407efd`): `tool/python/vendor.lock.json` pins the generator to `0aee64da`. Dart `tool/build_metadata.dart` keeps app-specific pubspec version/build and a dirty-state Git read. No Dart tool-version probe was found.
- mcp-toolcall-lab (`fb9e91e1`): the vendored generator is pinned to `0aee64da`, and `repository_diagnostics.py` passes `tooling={"python": platform.python_version()}` locally.
- Identity migrations (web-ui #29, flutter_navigation_basic #127, mcp-toolcall-lab #87) are integrated but do not complete the tooling consolidation. No open PR implements a #49 consumer slice.

## Consumer progress — 2026-10-05 JST

From: GPT
To: repository owner / consumer maintainers

- [x] Producer #51 is integrated; do not recreate its portable-tooling observation implementation.
- [x] [web-ui #38](https://github.com/myon-bioinformatics/web-ui/pull/38) merged on 2026-10-04 at 20:17 JST as `53ea218fae0dab039384a12bbdfcdab7348ee52a`. Its producer/contract/LICENSE are vendored from Ironmate `73157cb7fed236a4a941722a6dcddd69a33ab95a`, rather than the old #46 pin. The current main collector directly calls `canonical.collect_portable_tooling()` and projects only present keys. This consumer slice is complete and must not be reimplemented.
- [ ] Flutter / mcp-toolcall-lab consumer reconciliation remains separate work. Generic portable observations belong to the canonical producer; Flutter/app/build-specific measurements remain consumer-owned. Completion of web-ui does not complete these migrations.
- [ ] Keep the parent open until the remaining consumer scope and acceptance criteria are satisfied.

The merge state and current web-ui collector were re-read for this status update. Existing test evidence remains in web-ui #38; this metadata-only update does not claim a new test run, change the v1 schema, change repository identity/provenance ownership, or move read-only inspector observations into a competing identity producer.
